definition.purpose: Classify MSFT directional setups from prior-session option GEX capital-type structure and issue notification-only paper plans.
definition.rationale: Ticker-specific GEX rules selected from full-period research; see strategy.md for rule-level rationale.
definition.source_refresh_gate: At/after 07:30 America/New_York on current US trading session D1: latest complete GEX ObservationDate must equal previous US trading session D0; exactly one BC/BP/SC/SP row; non-null GEXDelta/Close/VWAP; 60 prior complete observations; canonical source revision stable for this heartbeat. Otherwise NOT_READY and create nothing.
